items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I took him over to meet this young black guy who was an excellent tennis player

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn't know him then, so I don't know.

Well, all I knew, I used to take him around with us all the time and all I knew was he had gone to UCLA for a year or two, and he used to play pretty good tennis. And the big tennis court over on La Cienega just off of Wilshire, and this is where I really met him, you know, because this was where tennis players, you know, they're really gamblers, and that's where they used to have big gambling matches, and I took him over to meet this young black guy who was an excellent tennis player - but he had never had a…
And that's how Norman and I became friends, because he liked jazz, and he was always around -- but he started to give all the names of the musicians, and that is a fact.
